objective: Repair the Pi extension entry (commit b7efd82 on release/0.3.0/feat/pi-extension, worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext) so a non-git project with a .holyagent folder gets its status, and close the review's optional notes.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-ext and run every command there. Gates: bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build.

Blocking (code review): in a project that is not a git repository but has a .holyagent folder, `holyagent state mode` exits 4 (StateIo: not a git repository), so `collect` in packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts fails and the session gets a failure notice instead of status (a session-role session also loses the root core). The Claude hook (packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts, hasStateFolder(call.directory)) works there. Fix: when the top came from the ctx.cwd fallback (no git toplevel), use <cwd>/.holyagent and skip `state mode`. Add a test with a real non-git project (temp dir with .holyagent and no git init) through the shipped wrapper.

Ride-along (optional review notes): (a) run status before reconcile in sequence, as the comment says, instead of an unbounded Effect.all; (b) give session_start one overall deadline matching the Claude hook's 10s, and run independent calls (such as state mode and config) together, so the worst case stays within it; (c) when session_compact starts a new gather, abort the older pending run instead of only overwriting it; (d) list in docs/pi/extensions.md under 'Not covered yet' that piContext omits the legacy-state notice, the cloud identity text and the setup notice; (e) update docs/pi/orchestration.md ('The runtime under Pi', Session context) to say handlers reach the runtime through scripts/holyagent; (f) remove the duplication: make folderExists reuse hasStateFolder from packages/runtime/src/cli/hook.ts (export it from a shared runtime module), and make the pi generate.ts runtime() and the Claude generate.ts bundle() share one bundler helper, keeping the Claude dist byte-identical; (g) security note (low, Windows): pi.exec of bare 'sh' and 'git' with cwd set to the project could resolve a program from the project folder on Windows; run them with a neutral cwd (for example the package's own directory) and pass the project explicitly (git -C <project>, the wrapper's own cwd handling), with a test that the exec cwd is not the project.
constraints: Unit tests and synthesized fixtures only; do not run the pi binary or a live model.
Keep the Claude generated output byte-identical (git status on packages/integrations/claude/dist after build).
Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths for the root to commit.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md (Effect, Schema at boundaries, JSDoc on exports, Bun APIs where Bun runs; the extension itself runs on Node).
Report in under 400 words; start each evidence line with the criterion text, a colon, then the support; put long logs in a file outside the repository.

criteria.text: A non-git project with a .holyagent folder gets status and, for the session role, the core span, with a real-project test
Status runs before reconcile, session_start has one 10s overall deadline, and a newer compaction gather aborts the older one, with tests
git and sh run with a cwd that is not the project, with a test
The state-folder check and the bundler are shared, not duplicated, and the Claude dist stays byte-identical
docs/pi/extensions.md and docs/pi/orchestration.md match the implementation
bunx --no-install mise run verify exits 0 and mise run build leaves generated output in sync
